footer_tagline: HR support for SMEs in Angola.
footer_note: Site under preparation. Contact details to be completed.
home_hero_title: Recruit and support your teams with Mwene Consulting
home_hero_subtitle: Mwene Consulting supports SMEs in Angola with recruitment, HR organisation and team skills development. Remote and on-site support, according to your needs and the terms agreed for each assignment.
home_service1_desc: We help you define the role, select candidates and conduct interviews. The final hiring decision remains yours.
home_service2_desc: We clarify roles, prepare the onboarding of new employees and set up tracking tools tailored to your team.
home_service3_desc: Training sessions on communication, interviewing or team management, defined according to your needs.
home_step1_desc: We discuss your situation, constraints and expectations.
home_step2_desc: We send you a clear proposal with the scope, deliverables and terms.
home_step3_desc: We carry out the planned actions and keep you informed at every step.
home_step4_desc: We deliver the agreed documents and review the results together.
home_about_text: Ritatelma Fernandes Ambrosio holds a master's degree in human resources and works in this field in France. She founded Mwene Consulting to offer her support to SMEs in Angola in structuring their teams and HR practices.
home_final_cta_title: Do you have an HR need in Angola?
home_final_cta_text: Tell us about your situation. We will review your request and get back to you to discuss it.
services_hero_subtitle: Mwene Consulting works across three complementary areas. Each assignment is defined according to your situation, needs and agreed deliverables. We send you a proposal before any commitment.
services_rec_need_text: You need to recruit but lack the time or method to identify and select the right profiles.
services_rec_p1: Clarification of needs and job definition.
services_rec_p5: Presentation of shortlisted candidates and interview summary.
services_rec_deliverables: Possible deliverables, depending on the agreed assignment
services_rec_del_text: Job description, interview guide, candidate summary. The quote will specify the deliverables included.
services_rec_note: The client company retains the final hiring decision.
services_hr_need_text: Your team is growing and you want to clarify roles, structure onboarding or set up tracking tools.
services_hr_p2: Clarifying roles and responsibilities within the team.
services_hr_p3: Preparing the onboarding of new employees.
services_hr_p4: Setting up tracking tools and interview templates.
services_hr_p5: Identifying HR priorities for your situation.
services_hr_del_text: Job descriptions, onboarding guide, interview templates, HR action plan. The quote will specify the deliverables included.
services_hr_note: This service does not automatically include payroll management, legal advice or full personnel management. These areas will be specified in the proposal.
services_train_need_text: You want to strengthen the skills of your managers or teams on concrete HR topics.
services_train_format_text: Content, duration, format and facilitators are defined according to your needs and availability. A proposal is sent after discussion.
services_quote_text: Every assignment is different. The price is defined according to the scope, agreed deliverables, time required and any travel. We send you a detailed proposal before any commitment. Quotes can be issued in euros or Angolan kwanzas (AOA) according to agreed terms.
about_founder_p1: Ritatelma Fernandes Ambrosio holds a master's degree in human resources and works in this field in France.
about_founder_p2: She founded Mwene Consulting to offer her support to SMEs in Angola, a market to which she wishes to contribute more structured and human HR practices.
about_founder_p3: She works remotely from France and can travel to Angola depending on the assignments and agreed terms.
about_mission_quote: Help businesses implement clear, useful and tailored HR practices.
about_p1_desc: Every situation is different. We start by understanding your context before making any recommendation.
about_p2_desc: We define together the scope, deliverables and terms before starting any assignment.
about_p3_desc: The documents and materials produced are designed to be directly usable by your team.
about_cta_text: Tell us about your situation. We will review your request and get back to you.
